name: Nakahara Haruka
source:
A 35-year-old housewife who lives next door to Kouta. She is a kind woman who cares about Kouta, who is alone most of the time and helps in any way she can.

Kouta also secretly has feelings for her.

She has a secret that she doesn't want anyone to know...

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mama-club2.html]official site[/url]]
